access_failures.detail: Several direct post fetches returned cache-miss errors, while the public channel preview exposed post identifiers, text, and displayed times.
Search results were dominated by historical pages and did not yield stable current daily briefing URLs for the bounded window.

coverage_gaps: Telegram public previews expose only a recent window and may not preserve later edits or deletions.
No immutable page captures were stored; source-item content hashes and artifact manifests therefore remain absent.
MAX and VK mirrors were not collected because the public-web search did not provide equally stable, directly inspectable post pages.
This is a bounded discovery pass, not an exhaustive survey of every Russian federal or regional official account.
